title: PRATIK Kernel Core — MVP (balanced-ternary, event-driven developmental kernel)
description: Reference minimum viable implementation of the PRATIK (Participatory Recursive Adaptive Trans-Intelligence Kernel) core for the PEDLER developmental Event Algebra. Computes over balanced ternary T={-1,0,+1} with no floating point in the core path; implements the autogenous spawning operator, a resource-modulated persistence functional and crystallization threshold theta_c = theta0/(E*M), and provisional-dimension evaporation. Ships a CPU (C++20) backend (built and verified), a compilation-ready CUDA backend (Unified Memory, asynchronous streams, atomicAdd dimension claim; not executed in the authoring environment), a verification harness proving the recollection theorem and the accommodation/crystallization axioms plus a 100k-event benchmark, and a dependency-free interactive 3D state visualizer.
